The C6 filter caught the pairing of DRAM with a price-surge/shortage token. 内容: 一条 Google News/MSN 标题报道称，在 Samsung DRAM 价格飙升之际，Apple 正考虑转向中国的 CXMT 采购 RAM 芯片。C6 过滤器捕捉到了 DRAM 与涨价/短缺关键词的配对。 Why it matters: Soaring DRAM prices are a memory-supply-stress signal: AI accelerators need vast HBM/DRAM, and buyers like Apple diversifying to CXMT signals real scarcity and pricing power at the memory makers. Rising memory costs squeeze the margins of everyone building AI infrastructure, tightening the bubble-stress picture. 影响: DRAM 价格飙升是内存供应紧张的信号：AI 加速器需要大量 HBM/DRAM，而 Apple 这样的买家转向 CXMT 分散供应，说明内存出现真实的稀缺和厂商的定价权。内存成本上升会挤压所有 AI 基础设施建设者的利润，加剧泡沫压力。

Sustained spikes like this raise the bill of materials for every AI server and compress hyperscaler capex efficiency, a classic late-cycle bubble-stress tell. 影响: DRAM 价格 700% 的涨幅是严重的内存供应紧张信号，说明 AI 数据中心对 HBM/DDR5 的需求正在挤占消费级与商品内存市场。这种持续暴涨会抬高每一台 AI 服务器的物料成本、压缩超大规模厂商的资本开支效率，是典型的周期晚期泡沫压力信号。

alerts.subject: [C10-MED] 10y Real Yield rising: 2.16% (+44bp off 90d-low)
alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-06-29
Current:  2.16%
90d low:  1.72%
Move:     +44bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year real (TIPS) yield rose to 2.16%, up 0.44 pp from its trailing-90-day low of 1.72% (as of 2026-06-29).

内容:
10 年期实际收益率（TIPS）升至 2.16%，较过去 90 天低点 1.72% 上升 0.44 个百分点（截至 2026-06-29）。

Why it matters:
Higher real yields raise the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex bets, where payback is years out — the present value of those future cash flows falls hardest. A real-yield spike also tightens financial conditions and competes with risk assets for capital, squeezing the most speculative end of the AI trade.

影响:
实际收益率走高抬升了长久期 AI capex 押注的贴现率——这类投资回本要等数年，未来现金流的现值跌得最狠。实际收益率飙升还会收紧金融条件，与风险资产争夺资金，挤压 AI 交易中最具投机性的部分。
